text: “After this, I will pour out my Spirit on all humanity. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions;
and also on male and female slaves in those days I will pour out my Spirit.
I will show wonders in the sky and on earth — blood, fire and columns of smoke.
The sun will be turned into darkness and the moon into blood before the coming of the great and terrible Day of ADONAI.”

At that time, whoever calls on the name of ADONAI will be saved. For in Mount Tziyon and Yerushalayim there will be those who escape, as ADONAI has promised; among the survivors will be those whom ADONAI has called.
